effect: The excavator cleared the surveyed bay, completing the chapter; the cave provides shelter but still has no breathable air.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the hopper and powered machine used for a concrete result, with the cave’s limitations made clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Clearing the bay paid off the excavator preparation with a physically understandable sequence: digging, collecting and transporting the spoil.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the excavator at the floor before connecting its lead was a redundant detour, although the compatibility feedback immediately corrected it.

surprise.text: The power cable and steel made a magnetic separator instead of powering the excavator. The coil’s operation was explained sensibly, but its immediate purpose was not clear.

arbitrary.text: Making the separator felt somewhat disconnected from the visible excavation goal; I did not learn what it was needed for during this chapter.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the cleared cave becomes usable. The practical details were engaging, though the unexpected separator made the route less clear.
